Scripts.OnEvent: if event == "PLAYER_LOGIN" then LWCP_HandlePlayerLogin() end if event == "PLAYER_LOGIN" or event == "PARTY_MEMBERS_CHANGED" then LWCP_UpdateInventoryTabState() end if event == "CHAT_MSG_SYSTEM" then LWCP_HandleSystemMsg(arg1) end if event == "CHAT_MSG_ADDON" then LWCP_HandleAddonMsg(arg1, arg2, arg3, arg4) end if event == "MODIFIER_STATE_CHANGED" then LWCP_HandleModifierStateChanged(arg1) end if event == "PLAYER_TARGET_CHANGED" then LWCP_HandleTargetChanged() end if event == "TRAINER_SHOW" then LWCP_HandleTrainerShow() end if event == "TRAINER_CLOSED" then LWCP_HandleTrainerClosed() end
